tasks.label: Verify project (Java 21, macOS)
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress verify

tasks.label: Run isolated learning benchmarks (Java 21, macOS)
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && python3 tools/benchmark.py

tasks.label: Run isolated scaling comparisons (Java 21, macOS)
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && python3 tools/scaling.py

tasks.label: Start monitoring (Prometheus and Grafana)
tasks.command: docker compose --profile monitoring up -d --wait postgres rabbitmq prometheus grafana

tasks.label: Stop monitoring (preserve data)
tasks.command: docker compose --profile monitoring stop prometheus grafana

tasks.label: Run platform (Java 21, macOS)
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && export MESSAGING_ENABLED=true && mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress spring-boot:run

tasks.label: Run API only (Java 21, macOS)
tasks.command: export JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" && export MESSAGING_ENABLED=false && mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress spring-boot:run
